runtime_lexical_hits.line_text: -- Create a date spine from 2016-01-01 to current date + 1 week
where date_day <= current_date + interval '1 week'
-- if it's not resolved include everything up to today. if it is, look at the last time it was updated
case when issue.resolved_at is null then current_timestamp else issue_history_scd.valid_starting_on::timestamp end)::date as open_until
where date_day <= current_date
,coalesce(issue_sprint.sprint_started_at <= current_timestamp
and coalesce(issue_sprint.sprint_completed_at, current_timestamp) >= current_timestamp
and coalesce(issue_sprint.sprint_completed_at, current_timestamp) >= current_timestamp
when i.resolved_at is null then extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - i.created_at)) / 86400.0
max(coalesce(i.resolved_at::date, current_date)) as latest_activity_date,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date >= current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_resolved_30d,
count(case when i.created_at::date >= current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_created_30d,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date >= current_date - interval '7 days' then 1 end) as issues_resolved_7d,
count(case when i.created_at::date >= current_date - interval '7 days' then 1 end) as issues_created_7d,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_resolved_prev_30d,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_resolved_prev_30d,
count(case when i.created_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_created_prev_30d
count(case when i.created_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_created_prev_30d
extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - created_at)) end) as numeric), 0) as median_age_currently_open_seconds,
extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - first_assigned_at)) end) as numeric), 0) as median_age_currently_open_assigned_seconds
sum(case when resolved_at is null then extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - created_at)) else 0 end) as sum_currently_open_duration_seconds,
extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - first_assigned_at)) else 0 end) as sum_currently_open_assigned_duration_seconds
where i.created_at between s.started_at and coalesce(s.completed_at, s.ended_at, current_timestamp)
coalesce(sb.complete_date, sb.end_date, current_date) as snapshot_date,
extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - last_assigned_at)) end) as numeric), 0) as median_age_currently_open_seconds
extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - last_assigned_at)) end) as sum_current_open_seconds
max(coalesce(resolved_at::date, current_date)) as end_date
extract('epoch' from (coalesce(resolved_at, current_timestamp) - created_at)) as open_duration_seconds,
extract('epoch' from (coalesce(resolved_at, current_timestamp) - first_assigned_at)) as any_assignment_duration_seconds,
extract('epoch' from (coalesce(resolved_at, current_timestamp) - last_assigned_at)) as last_assignment_duration_seconds,
extract('epoch' from (coalesce(ie.resolved_at, current_timestamp) - ie.created_at)) / 86400.0 as total_lifecycle_days,
extract('epoch' from (coalesce(ie.resolved_at, current_timestamp) - ie.first_assigned_at)) / 86400.0 as assigned_duration_days,
when i.resolved_at is null and extract('epoch' from (current_timestamp - i.created_at)) / 86400.0 > 90 then 1
count(case when i.created_at::date >= current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_created_30d,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date >= current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_resolved_30d,
count(case when i.created_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_created_prev_30d,
count(case when i.created_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_created_prev_30d,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_resolved_prev_30d,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date between current_date - interval '60 days' and current_date - interval '30 days' then 1 end) as issues_resolved_prev_30d,
count(distinct case when i.created_at::date >= current_date - interval '30 days' then i.assignee_user_id end) as active_assignees_30d,
count(distinct case when i.created_at::date >= current_date - interval '90 days' then i.assignee_user_id end) as active_assignees_90d,
count(case when i.created_at::date >= current_date - interval '30 days' and (i.priority_id ilike '%high%' or i.priority_id ilike '%critical%') then 1 end) as high_priority_created_30d,
count(case when i.resolved_at::date >= current_date - interval '30 days' and (i.priority_id ilike '%high%' or i.priority_id ilike '%critical%') then 1 end) as high_priority_resolved_30d
and date_day = cast(current_timestamp as date))
avg(extract('epoch' from (coalesce(ir.resolved_at, current_timestamp) - ir.created_at)) / 86400.0) as avg_reported_issue_lifecycle_days,
avg(extract('epoch' from (coalesce(ia.resolved_at, current_timestamp) - ia.created_at)) / 86400.0) as avg_assigned_resolution_days,
current_date as last_active_date,
and i.created_at >= current_date - interval '90 days'
where s.started_at >= current_date - interval '180 days'
extract('epoch' from (current_date::timestamp - min(i.created_at::date)::timestamp)) / 86400.0 as days_since_first_issue,
case when current_date - uas.last_active_date > 7 then true else false end as inactive_recently,
